drums.description: Samba Batucada, This percussion ensemble piece features a high-pitched repinique leading the call-and-response patterns, The rhythmic core consists of deep, resonant surdo drums playing syncopated low-end pulses, A metallic agogô bell provides a constant melodic-rhythmic ostinato, Shakers and tamborims add high-frequency sixteenth-note subdivisions with sharp, staccato accents, The arrangement follows a traditional Brazilian street parade structure with sudden breaks and unison rhythmic shifts, 132 BPM, Key of C, 4/4 time signature Publish
